root.name: Sicilian Defense: Smith-Morra Gambit Declined, Alapin Formation
root.moves: 1. e4 c5 2. d4 cxd4 3. c3 Nf6

overview: Black declines the Smith-Morra pawn with 3...Nf6 and White usually plays 4.e5 Nd5 5.Nf3 (or 5.cxd4), reaching an Alapin-type structure where Black recaptures on d4 and has the d5 knight in front of White's e5 pawn. White has space and an initiative; Black develops with ...Nc6, ...e6 and ...d6, aiming to undermine the e5 pawn.

white_ideas.idea: Gain space with e5, recapture on d4 and develop with Nf3, Bc4 and O-O.
Attack Black's d5 knight and the e5 pawn's support.

black_ideas.idea: Hit e5 with ...d6 and ...Nc6, develop with ...e6 and ...Be7.
Use the half-open c-file and trade pieces against White's space.

typical_structures.structure: Alapin-style with White's c3/d4/e5 pawns against ...d6 and the knight on d5.

character.notes: A calm Alapin-type position; White has space but little forcing play, and Black is comfortable.

gambit.notes: The gambit is declined; material is level after recapture on d4 or c3.

soundness.notes: A sound declined line for Black and fine for White.

structure.notes: Asymmetric Sicilian with White's pawn centre and Black's half-open c-file.

approach.notes: A normal Sicilian response; the Alapin is a standard anti-Sicilian.

level.notes: Understanding the e5 pawn and Black's counterplay; moderate theory.

sublines_that_differ.name: Push Variation
sublines_that_differ.how: Black pushes the pawn to d3, a different and trappy structure.

sublines_that_differ.name: Scandinavian Formation
sublines_that_differ.how: Black strikes the centre at once, with exchanges.

character.reason: Alapin-type structure, neither especially solid nor sharp.

gambit.reason: The pawn is declined and material stays level.

soundness.reason: A sound Sicilian line for both sides.

structure.reason: Every Sicilian is Semi-open; Black has the c-file.

level.reason: Understanding of the e5 pawn matters more than memory.

plans.reason: White gains space with e5 and Black attacks it.
